title: Maximum Frequency Score of a Subarray
summary: Given an integer array nums and a positive integer k, calculate the maximum frequency score of any subarray of size k.
statement: Given an integer array nums and a positive integer k, calculate the maximum frequency score of any subarray of size k. The frequency score is the sum of distinct values raised to their frequencies, modulo 10^9 + 7. A subarray is a consecutive segment of nums.
constraints: For a window, each distinct value x with frequency f contributes x^f modulo 1,000,000,007.
The window score is the modular sum of those contributions.
Return the maximum score among all contiguous windows of exactly k elements.
hints: Maintain a frequency map and the current score for one length-k window.
Before changing a frequency, subtract its old power contribution; afterward add its new one.
Slide one position at a time by removing the outgoing value and adding the incoming value.
Each update preserves the exact score invariant, so taking the maximum over all window positions returns the required result.
editorial: Each update preserves the exact score invariant, so taking the maximum over all window positions returns the required result.
